name: Customer Service Representative

sections.daily_work: Help customers with questions, orders, and complaints. Handle phone, email, and chat support. Resolve issues calmly. Document interactions. Escalate complex problems.
sections.learning: Communication skills, conflict resolution, product knowledge, CRM software, patience and empathy, problem-solving, multi-tasking, basic data entry.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $28,000-$40,000 USD. Experienced representatives $35,000-$55,000. Team leads and supervisors $50,000-$70,000. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: High school diploma, on-the-job training, customer-facing retail or food service experience, call center positions, communication skills courses.

try_in_real_life: Practice active listening: have a conversation focusing only on understanding
Shadow a customer service representative or call center agent
Take a free customer service skills course online
Volunteer at an information desk at a community event
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
